_comment: Hand review of every card for The Forge (2026-11-18): what +1 does, what the card does, and how it grows from +2 to +9. tools/forge_curves.py turns it into curves.json.

ABRASIVE.note: Thorns replay is safe; Dexterity also grows by 1 per level to fit the defensive power

ABUNDANCE.effect: Exhaust: choose 1 of 3 upgraded Powers, free this turn
ABUNDANCE.note: Cost already 0 at +1; a tiny Draw per level to find the Power's synergies, Exhaust keeps it safe, capped at 5

ACCELERANT.note: Extra Poison triggers are a multiplier: cap 5

ACCURACY.note: Shiv damage bonus is safe to replay to +9

ADAPTIVE_STRIKE.effect: Deal 18 damage, add a 0-cost copy to discard

AFTERIMAGE.effect: Whenever you play a card, gain 1 Block (AfterimagePower 1)
AFTERIMAGE.note: Block per card grows by 1 per level; Innate is already given

AGGRESSION.effect: Each turn start, put a random Attack from discard into hand and Upgrade it (AggressionPower 1, hardcoded)
AGGRESSION.note: One more Attack recovered per turn per level (amount = attacks taken); card generation: cap 5

ALCHEMIZE.note: Cost hits 0 at +1; potions stay one per play, so add a small alchemical Poison per level

ALL_FOR_ONE.effect: Deal 10, put all 0-cost cards from discard into hand

ANGER.effect: Deal 6, add a copy to discard

ANOINTED.effect: Exhaust: put every Rare from draw pile into hand
ANOINTED.note: No number; it is about fetching cards, so a small Draw per level (Exhaust, cap 5)

APOTHEOSIS.effect: Exhaust, Innate: upgrade every other card in combat
APOTHEOSIS.note: Cost reaches 0 at +2; ascension theme: gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity per level (Exhaust, once per combat)

APPARITION.note: Intangible grows by 1 per level: cap 3

ARMAMENTS.plus1: IsUpgraded: upgrade every card in hand instead of one
ARMAMENTS.effect: Gain 5 Block, upgrade a card in hand
ARMAMENTS.note: The +1 changes no number; the Block var grows by 3 per level

ARSENAL.effect: Whenever you create a card, gain 1 Strength (ArsenalPower 1)
ARSENAL.note: Strength per created card grows by 1 per level; Strength is safe

ASHEN_STRIKE.note: Damage per exhausted card is safe to replay; base damage also keeps up

ASSASSINATE.effect: 0 cost, Innate, Exhaust: deal 10, apply 1 Vulnerable
ASSASSINATE.note: Damage and Vulnerable replay are safe

ASTRAL_PULSE.effect: 3 stars: deal 6 to all enemies twice

AUTOMATION.effect: Every 10 cards drawn, gain 1 energy (AutomationPower = energy)
AUTOMATION.note: Cost hits 0 at +1; the Energy var grows instead, energy: cap 3 (cost lowering, if any, still applies)

BACKFLIP.note: Block replay is safe; draw stays 2

BANSHEES_CRY.effect: Deal 33 to all enemies; costs 2 less per Ethereal card played
BANSHEES_CRY.note: Cost-only: keeps dropping by 2 to 0 at +5; damage also grows by 5 per level so it keeps scaling

BARRICADE.effect: Block is not removed at turn start (BarricadePower, single)
BARRICADE.note: Cost-only drops to 0 at +3; the power cannot stack, so a Block bonus per level fits the theme

BASH.note: Damage and Vulnerable replay are safe

BATTLE_TRANCE.effect: 0 cost: draw 3, no more draw this turn

BEACON_OF_HOPE.effect: Whenever you gain Block on your turn, allies gain half of it (single stack, 50% hardcoded)
BEACON_OF_HOPE.note: Single-stack power with a hardcoded 50%; Block on play feeds the share to allies

BEAM_CELL.note: Damage and Vulnerable replay are safe

BEAT_DOWN.note: Cards here are free extra plays of Attacks, not draw: cap 3

BEAT_INTO_SHAPE.effect: Deal 5, Forge 5 + 5 per time the target was hit this turn
BEAT_INTO_SHAPE.note: Forge per hit is a per-hit multiplier: cap 5; base and damage keep growing

BEGONE.plus1: IsUpgraded: the Minion Strike is upgraded
BEGONE.effect: Transform a card in hand into a Minion Strike
BEGONE.note: No var; a small Damage per level to the target or a random enemy fits the banishing theme

BIASED_COGNITION.effect: Gain 5 Focus, lose 1 Focus each turn

BIG_BANG.effect: 0 cost, Exhaust: draw 1, gain 1 star, 1 energy, Forge 5
BIG_BANG.note: The +1 grows no var; everything grows by 1 (Forge by 5) per level, energy/stars: cap 3, Forge keeps growing

BLACK_HOLE.effect: Whenever you gain or spend stars, deal 3 to all enemies
BLACK_HOLE.note: Damage per star event is safe to replay

BLADE_SYMPHONY.effect: Multiplayer: each teammate adds 2 Shivs to hand
BLADE_SYMPHONY.note: Cost-only drops to 0 at +2; then more Shivs per teammate, card generation: cap 5

BLIGHT_STRIKE.effect: Deal 8, apply Doom equal to damage dealt
BLIGHT_STRIKE.note: Damage replay also grows the Doom

BLOODLETTING.note: Energy: cap 3; HP cost limits it

BLUR.effect: Gain 5 Block, Block is kept next turn (Blur 1)

BODY_SLAM.effect: Deal damage equal to your Block (ExtraDamage 1 x Block)

BOMBARDMENT.effect: Exhaust: deal 18, replays itself from the exhaust pile each turn

BONE_SHARDS.note: Damage and Block replay are safe

BOOST_AWAY.effect: 0 cost: gain 6 Block, add a Dazed to discard

BORROWED_TIME.effect: Gain 4 energy, your cards cost 1 more this turn

BOUNCING_FLASK.effect: Apply 3 Poison to a random enemy 3 times
BOUNCING_FLASK.note: Bounces are Poison hits, not card plays: cap 5 on bounces, Poison per bounce keeps growing

BRAND.effect: 0 cost: lose 1 HP, exhaust a card, gain 1 Strength

BREAK.note: Damage and Vulnerable replay are safe

BREAKTHROUGH.effect: Lose 1 HP, deal 9 to all enemies

BRIGHTEST_FLAME.effect: 0 cost: gain 2 energy, draw 2, lose 2 max HP

BUBBLE_BUBBLE.effect: Apply 9 Poison to a poisoned enemy

BULK_UP.effect: Lose 1 orb slot, gain 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity

BULLY.note: Damage per Vulnerable is safe to replay

BULWARK.note: Block and Forge replay are safe

BUNDLE_OF_JOY.effect: Exhaust: add 3 random colorless cards to hand

BURST.effect: This turn, your next Skill is played an extra time (BurstPower)

CALCULATED_GAMBLE.effect: 0 cost, Exhaust: discard your hand, draw that many

CALL_OF_THE_VOID.effect: Each turn, add 1 random Ethereal card to hand (Cards 1)

CAPACITOR.note: Repeat is orb slots here, not plays: orbs cap 5

CAPTURE_SPIRIT.note: Card generation: cap 5; damage keeps growing

CELESTIAL_MIGHT.note: Extra hits: cap 3; damage per hit also grows and keeps growing past it

CHAOS.note: Repeat is orbs channeled: orbs cap 5

CHARGE.plus1: IsUpgraded: the Minion Dive Bombs are upgraded
CHARGE.effect: Transform 2 cards from your draw pile into Minion Dive Bombs
CHARGE.note: The +1 grows no var; one more card transformed per level, card generation: cap 5

CHARGE_BATTERY.effect: Gain 7 Block, gain 1 energy next turn
CHARGE_BATTERY.note: Block replay is safe; energy stays 1

CHILD_OF_THE_STARS.effect: Whenever you spend stars, gain 2 Block per star
CHILD_OF_THE_STARS.note: Block per star replay is safe

CHILL.note: No var; Frost is the defensive orb, so a small Block per level fits

CINDER.effect: Deal 18, exhaust a random card in hand

CLOAK_AND_DAGGER.effect: Gain 6 Block, add 1 Shiv to hand
CLOAK_AND_DAGGER.note: Shiv generation: cap 5; Block also grows and keeps growing past it

COLLISION_COURSE.effect: 0 cost: deal 10, add a Debris to hand

COMPACT.effect: Gain 6 Block, transform Statuses in hand into Fuel

CRIMSON_MANTLE.effect: Each turn, take self damage (1 per Mantle played) and gain 7 Block

DANSE_MACABRE.effect: Whenever you play a card costing 2+, gain 4 Block
